lines.beaver_en: Hello. How is your physical condition these days?
lines.en: I'm tired lately, so I don't feel refreshed even in the morning.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Do you get enough sleep?
lines.en: Yes, but my eyelid keeps twitching.

lines.beaver: 피로 때문일 수 있어요. 관절은 어떻습니까?
lines.beaver_en: It may be from fatigue. How are your joints?
lines.beaver_roman: Piro ttaemunil su isseoyo. Gwanjeoreun eotteoseumnikka?
lines.learner: 무릎 관절이 아프고 척추도 좀 뻐근해요.
lines.en: My knee joints hurt, and my spine is a bit stiff too.
lines.roman: Mureup gwanjeori apeugo cheokchudo jom ppeogeunhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Has your lower body ever felt numb or cold?
lines.learner: 네, 다리가 차서 혈액순환이 안 된대요.
lines.en: Yes, my legs are cold, and I was told my blood circulation is poor.
lines.roman: Ne, dariga chaseo hyeoraeksunhwani an doendaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: We'll check your arteries too. Is your digestion good?
lines.learner: 식후에 복부가 더부룩하고 트림이 자주 나요.
lines.en: After meals my abdomen feels bloated, and I burp often.
lines.roman: Sikhue bokbuga deoburukago teurimi jaju nayo.

lines.beaver: 속에 가스가 찬 것 같네요. 기침은요?
lines.beaver_en: It seems gas has built up inside. Any cough?
lines.beaver_roman: Soge gaseuga chan geot ganneyo. Gichimeunyo?
lines.en: My bronchial tubes are weak, so my throat hurts when I cough.

lines.beaver_en: Your throat must have been very uncomfortable. How about other senses?
lines.learner: 감기 후 후각이 떨어졌고 촉각은 괜찮아요.
lines.en: My sense of smell got worse after a cold, but my touch is fine.
lines.roman: Gamgi hu hugagi tteoreojyeotgo chokgageun gwaenchanayo.

lines.beaver: 손 힘도 볼게요. 이걸 꽉 쥐어 보세요.
lines.beaver_en: Let me check your hand strength. Squeeze this tightly.
lines.beaver_roman: Son himdo bolgeyo. Igeol kkwak jwieo boseyo.
lines.learner: 손아귀 힘이 약하다는 소리를 자주 들어요.
lines.en: I'm often told my grip is weak.
lines.roman: Sonagwi himi yakadaneun sorireul jaju deureoyo.

lines.beaver: 기구는 살균했습니다. 본인 확인용 지문도 찍어 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: The device has been sterilized. Please scan your fingerprint for ID.
lines.beaver_roman: Giguneun salgyunhaetseumnida. Bonin hwaginyong jimundo jjigeo juseyo.
lines.en: Okay, I'll scan my fingerprint here.

lines.beaver_en: Results will be out in a week. Thank you for your effort.
lines.en: Thank you. I feel refreshed after talking about it.
